framePolicy: Every original decoded source frame in order. No interpolation, repeated temporal padding, skipped frames, reversal or synthetic final pose.
staticManagementArt: Existing official sprites and all splash art remain unchanged. Pending forms are graphic previews, never playable definitions.

visualReview.scope: Independent visual review of first/middle/final frame of every five-action set on light and dark backgrounds; not a frame-by-frame manual review. Original overview and official sprite are references; all original frame preservation is verified separately.

rootMarkerCrossReview.result: No obvious incorrect cue in the eight reviewed plans; source-native anticipation versus first clearly released effect/recoil is consistent.

118.observation: Clean light/dark samples; native water orb and blue/white body remain intact. KO final retains only tiny native particles.

121.observation: All samples retain shape and native effects. Residual native KO fade ambiguity: original frame93 fades the orange body into the saturated green screen; base key leaves a darker olive, partially transparent body rather than fabricating its original orange. 123.observation: Blue key correctly retains the intrinsic green-grey body and yellow bolts. Native attack bloom remains as a faint soft halo, without solid blue screen patches. KO final retains the native prone body and smoke.

124.observation: Blue key retains green-grey body, yellow lightning and purple dark hair. All five sampled actions are clean on light/dark; native KO final consists of the original scattered particles, preserved.

125.observation: White/cyan body, dark paw details, ice arcs, particles and native final prone body with cold vapour all remain intact on both backgrounds. No re-key needed.

126.observation: White/cyan fur and ice spikes, dark paw details, translucent ice particles and grey native ground vapour remain readable on both backgrounds. Native final prone body retained without synthetic pose replacement.

127.observation: Blue key preserves the original green leaves/stems and pink/white petals with the intended clear gaps between tendrils. Native small green palm charge and pale orbit effect remain readable; final KO pink particles retained. No solid blue backing observed.

128.observation: Black/purple body, magenta wing membranes and pale violet native sweep retain contrast. KO final preserves the original near-empty tiny traces instead of inventing a held body pose; no green patches observed.

129.observation: Dark purple body and wings, bright claw arc and cyan/violet victory sweeps remain intact on light/dark. KO ending contains native dim residual energy with no fabricated held pose; no re-key needed.

130.observation: Actual encoded atlas reviewed after idle-only profile. Idle native yellow/lime/cyan gradients remain within the body; true gaps between antennae, limbs and wing tips remain clear. Attack47 orb/ribbon is white/cyan rather than the rejected green candidate. Hit/victory and final KO particles retain the base key; no new green spill observed.

131.observation: Actual encoded atlas reviewed after idle-only profile. Idle rainbow ribbons retain native lime/cyan interiors and the official negative-space holes remain clear. Attack arc and victory47 ground rune remain cyan/white, without the green regression from the rejected all-action profile. Native final KO faint particles preserved.

134.observation: Actual encoded atlas reviewed after idle-only profile. Idle body lime/cyan gradients and floating native multicolour drops stay intact, with clear gaps. Attack47 slash remains cyan/pink/yellow, without the rejected restored green underside. KO93 preserves original cyan glass-like fragments, bubbles and small remaining ribbon fragments with no invented figure.

139.observation: Actual encoded atlas all5actions sampled on light/dark. Grey-brown stone body, wing highlights and glowing cyan eyes remain distinct. Attack cyan wing-wisp effect, grey dust and native final collapsed stone body among dust/debris retained. No green screen patches observed.

observations: All three first/middle/last idle samples improve native lime/cyan ribbon and body gradients, with true negative-space cutouts preserved. Official front PNGs were opened independently as alpha references.

Global use of the profile is rejected:130attack47 restores green contamination in the orb/ribbon;131victory47 turns the native ground rune green;134attack47 adds green under the slash and134ko93 recolours several faded bubbles.

Recommend profile limited to the audited idle action, preserving the existing base key for action effects and native fades. Awaiting implemented action-limited candidate; no converter edits by reviewer.

finalProfile.limitation: This protects audited idle gradients only; action body gradients retain the existing base key to avoid false restoration of green screen contamination in bright effects and native fades.

nativeIdleCycleReview.policy: Retain all94originalframes in source order. No padding, interpolation, added crossfade or fabricated motion. These are native cycle limitations, retained in the loop review queue.

124.observation: Visible effect phase pop at93->0: small remaining fragments switch to full shoulder/arm yellow zigzags. The ground and broad body stance stay largely stable; head and hand phase has a small offset. This is not a large translation of the whole body.

125.observation: Noticeable head-tilt reset at93->0: the last frame has a more upright head, the first a tilted one. Paws and ground plane remain broadly stable. Do not claim a seamless idle loop.

134.observation: Threshold flagged, with subtle body/head phase, iridescent texture and small surrounding droplet-position differences at93->0. The broad stance and ground remain stable. No obvious large high-contrast pop in the inspected boundary stills comparable to124lightning or125head tilt; this is not proof of a mathematically seamless loop. Retain automatic review-queue entry.

nativeIdleCycleReview.scopeLimit: These observations compare original boundary frames and encoded loop-seam stills; no claim of a complete manual playback of every native frame.

timing.evidence: Ali alte, nessun arco che attraversa il petto. Il becco si apre e comincia la falciata delle ali verso il corpo. La falciata prosegue e le scie azzurre si estendono davanti al tronco.
Il proiettile sta arrivando da sinistra, senza flash sul corpo. Primo flash bianco sul volto al contatto del proiettile. Il flash si allarga sul petto mentre il corpo comincia a rinculare.
La sfera viene portata verso terra durante la discesa. Compare lo spruzzo bianco alla base della sfera nel primo contatto col suolo. Lo spruzzo cresce mentre la sfera completa la discesa.
Il corpo mantiene i colori normali nella posa raccolta. Primo fotogramma con flash bianco che copre la sagoma. Il flash continua prima che il corpo si sollevi nel rinculo.
Scie viola attorno al corpo; nessun getto distaccato dalla bocca. Compare il primo getto scuro davanti alla bocca. Il getto si allunga verso sinistra, separandosi dalla sagoma.
Occhi chiusi e testa abbassata prima del flash. Primo nucleo bianco sul volto durante la reazione al colpo. Il bagliore si espande e la testa comincia ad arretrare.
Le aperture posteriori mostrano soltanto il bagliore interno. Compaiono le prime fiammelle fuori dalle due aperture posteriori. Le fiammelle crescono mentre il corpo si abbassa.
Volto e corazza privi del flash d'impatto. Compare il primo flash bianco sul volto. Il flash si espande mentre il capo si ritrae.
Il corpo è sospeso con le zampe anteriori protese. Le zampe raggiungono il suolo e compaiono i primi bagliori al contatto. I bagliori e la polvere si espandono ai piedi della figura.
La corazza mantiene la posa iniziale senza flash. Compare il primo flash giallo al centro della corazza. Il flash si allarga sopra la testa e comincia il rinculo.
Ali distese quasi orizzontalmente, prima della falciata luminosa. Le punte delle ali cominciano la falciata e compare il primo arco bianco. L'arco si allunga lungo il battito e il corpo avanza.

Testa ancora allineata alla posizione precedente e ali basse. Gli occhi si chiudono e il capo si solleva nel primo rinculo evidente. Il becco si apre mentre il collo e il tronco proseguono il rinculo.

Il corpo inizia il salto con le braccia aperte, prima del grande bagliore. Le scariche esterne si allargano e il corpo viene illuminato dal primo bagliore forte. Il salto e la scarica radiale continuano.
Occhi serrati e nessuna sagoma gialla d'impatto sul corpo. Compare il primo flash giallo dentato attorno al volto e al tronco. Il flash si allarga mentre gli occhi si aprono nella reazione.
Il braccio è proteso, con la scia larga ancora tenue. Compare l'arco luminoso intenso attorno alla mano che avvia la falciata. L'arco segue il movimento della mano verso il basso.

Il corpo conserva ancora la posa iniziale con entrambi i piedi bassi. Gli occhi si spalancano, il tronco arretra e un piede si solleva nella reazione. Il rinculo continua con arti separati e corpo inclinato.
First pale cyan claw arc appears beside the raised forepaw; previous frame is airborne wind-up without that arc.
First white cyan impact spark crosses the muzzle and chest; subsequent frames expand it while the body recoils.
First pale slash fragment separates beneath the moving forepaw after the crouch and lift; the following stroke strengthens into the long native claw arc.
White cyan impact flash first appears across the chest while the figure is lifted; adjacent frames show pre-impact motion and expansion.
After the green palm charge, a detached pink crescent appears above the left side and then expands into an orbiting sweep.
First white impact flare crosses the flower-like head before expanding into the ring.
The first purple curved slash appears behind the raised foreclaw, then extends across the body during the sweep.
First white recoil streak appears around the lower body after the head-and-body anticipation.
The charged hand begins its forward sweep and a detached pale purple blade appears above the figure.
First pale diagonal impact slash crosses the chest; previous frame has no slash and the next broadens it.
The compact rainbow orb in front of the mouth opens into a released white cyan ribbon rather than remaining a charged ball.
A white starburst first appears behind the figure as its eyes open in surprise; adjacent frames show anticipation and expansion.
The raised foreclaw drives forward and releases the first broad cyan-purple overhead arc, before the later large starburst.
First distinct pale spectral curl forms outside the head above the glowing horn and then grows across it. Native source has a stun-like head halo rather than an external chest strike.
The raised hand begins its long forward sweep and gains a distinct pale arc above the fingers; the previous frame has only the small wind-up glow and following frame extends the rainbow blade.
First yellow-white impact spark appears at the muzzle and upper chest, before the brighter white pink expansion.
First cyan energy fragments appear behind the raised wing tips as the wings start the released downstroke; adjacent frames show fully open wings before and expanding wisps after.
First cyan head flash, dark stone fragment and ground dust appear together; previous frame is clean and next expands debris.
